quadruped.description: Low body with a trunk plate, four contact limbs in two diagonal gait groups, and optional tail, head and ear parts.

body.note: Remainder plate; drawn by the rig, never cut.

limb.note: Paws. phase 0 and 1 select the diagonal gait group; every limb needs a contact point.

biped.description: Upright body with a torso plate, two contact legs, optional arms, head and tail.

body.note: Torso plate; the remainder after parts are cut out.

leg.note: Feet. phase 0 and 1 select the stepping side; every leg needs a contact point.

arm.note: phase 0 and 1 pair the arms with the legs of the same phase (arms counter-swing automatically in the templates).
